# scon_issuer (Resource)

The issuer records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `allowed_subjects` (List of String)
- `audience` (String) Required for oidc and entra
- `client_id` (String)
- `issuer_url` (String) https, trailing `/` trimmed; required for oidc and entra
- `jwks_url` (String)
- `kind` (String) `oidc` on create
